title: Missing intermediate health contributors resolve as absent
summary: Reads a known healthy leaf and a missing terminal child on the same owned composite using the original health module.

change.description: Health endpoint traversal stops at the first missing child. The HTTP result should remain a missing resource even when more path segments follow that child.

notes: The two original S32 health modules are first on their own classpaths. Both run over the same pinned Jersey/Tomcat transport from S34. This caller covers the two terminal-leaf controls.

On the merged health class, a bytecode check found an immediate return after a missing child. The two public intermediate-path claims remain open. [Merged class evidence](../../verification/merged-pr-links/s01-s50/repaired-guards.json)
